name: aguaone-whatsapp-bot
description: Ultra-Low Latency WhatsApp Bot & Live Agent CRM for AGUAONE

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.db:reset: node -e "const Database = require('better-sqlite3'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const p = path.resolve('data/bot.db'); if (fs.existsSync(p)) { const db = new Database(p); db.exec('DELETE FROM messages; DELETE FROM notes; DELETE FROM contacts; VACUUM;'); console.log('✅ Database tables (contacts, messages, notes) cleared successfully!'); } else { console.log('No database file found to clear.'); }"
